main_body: Narrow strip, about 16px wide by 48px tall, made of a light-wood vertical post on the left and three repeated dark panels with small wooden blocks on the right. It reads as a flat front-facing fence or rail strip.
top_band: none: column x=8 starts with a dark outline row, then a 1-row light highlight (L=173) and a few mid-tone rows. No multi-row lighter horizontal surface is visible. The column at x=3 is one uniform tone across rows 0-47.
evidence: The left strip is a flat vertical post with a single tone down all 48 rows and no top surface. The right side repeats three identical dark-framed wooden blocks, each drawn face-on with only a 1-row highlight (L=173) at the top, which is a rim and not a surface. No horizontal beam or base shows a top face, so this is a front elevation. The piece also does not clearly read as an open frame or rack.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 8 colours per tile against 17-20. Its dark outline has a brown tint (0% neutral), so the outline is acceptable. The wooden blocks have a few texture dots, but the post is one flat tone for the full height. It is simple and thinner than the references, and its density is much lower.
